onrobot.zh: OnRobot A/S 于 2018 年由 On Robot、OptoForce 与 Perception Robotics 合并成立，总部位于丹麦欧登塞。其业务面向工业机器人和协作机器人的硬件、软件与应用部署。
onrobot.en: OnRobot A/S was formed in 2018 by merging On Robot, OptoForce and Perception Robotics. Based in Odense, Denmark, it supplies hardware, software and application-deployment solutions for industrial and collaborative robots.

onrobot.zh: OnRobot 以统一的机械与电气连接体系组织末端工具产品，面向多个机器人品牌提供共同的集成平台。产品组合包括电动、真空、磁力及柔性夹持工具，并延伸到视觉、力/力矩感知、打磨和拧紧工具。
onrobot.en: A common mechanical and electrical interface connects the OnRobot tooling ecosystem across robot brands. Its portfolio includes electric, vacuum, magnetic and soft gripping, alongside vision, force/torque sensing, sanding and screwdriving tools.
onrobot.locator: The One Stop Shop / unified mechanical and electrical system

onrobot.zh: 应用层包括码垛用 LIFT100 升降轴与 Pallet Station 配套件、WebLytics 生产监测，以及 D:PLOY 应用部署平台。公司还通过集成合作伙伴提供由 D:PLOY 支持的成套应用方案，覆盖码垛、机床上下料等任务。
onrobot.en: Application products include the LIFT100 palletizing lift, Pallet Station accessories, WebLytics production monitoring and the D:PLOY deployment platform. Integration partners also deliver complete D:PLOY-powered solutions for tasks including palletizing and machine tending.

onrobot.zh: 官网列示超过 700 家分销与系统集成合作伙伴，并提供在线培训和全球支持网络。其服务覆盖包装、抓取搬运、码垛、机床上下料、打磨与拧紧等制造工序。
onrobot.en: The company page lists more than 700 distribution and system-integration partners, supported by online training and a global support network. Applications include packaging, pick and place, palletizing, machine tending, sanding and screwdriving.
onrobot.locator: The One Stop Shop / partners; online training

robotiq.zh: Robotiq 围绕机器人抓取与接触作业开发自动化产品，业务目标是将重复性人工操作转移给机器人。公司强调使制造现场的搬运任务可靠运行，而非单纯复刻人手形态。
robotiq.en: Robotiq develops automation for robotic handling and contact tasks, aiming to transfer repetitive manual operations to robots. Its stated focus is reliable handling in manufacturing rather than reproducing the anatomy of a human hand.

robotiq.zh: 官网将业务划分为组件、软件和工作站。组件包括自适应夹爪、真空夹具、力/力矩与触觉传感器以及腕部相机；工作站面向码垛、机床上下料和拧紧，软件产品包括 IQ 与 Contact Core。
robotiq.en: The website separates Components, Software and Workcells. Components include adaptive and vacuum grippers, force/torque and tactile sensing, and a wrist camera. Workcells address palletizing, machine tending and screwdriving; software includes IQ and Contact Core.
robotiq.locator: What we do / Workcells; Components; Software

robotiq.zh: Robotiq 将降低人工集成负担列为研发方向，提出 Automatic Integration，并将面向物理 AI 的接触层与未来工作站部署联系起来。这是公司公开的技术方向，不等同于所有型号已经具备同一套自主集成能力。
robotiq.en: Robotiq identifies reduced manual integration as a development priority through Automatic Integration and a contact layer for physical AI in future workcells. This is its stated technical direction, not a claim that every model already offers identical autonomous-integration capabilities.
robotiq.locator: How we approach automation / Automatic Integration

robotiq.zh: 公司在北美和欧洲设有办公室，并通过跨地区团队、集成商和分销伙伴支持制造业客户。业务交付既包含可集成的独立组件，也包含围绕具体工序组织的工作站。
robotiq.en: The company reports offices in North America and Europe and serves manufacturers through regional teams, integrators and distribution partners. Its offering combines independently integrated components with workcells organized around specific production tasks.

sake-robotics.zh: SAKE Robotics 的公开产品以 EZGripper 机器人夹爪为核心。欠驱动手指在夹持较小物件时保持近似平行，在接触较大物体时可顺应外形包覆；位置与扭矩控制用于调节夹持动作和力度。
sake-robotics.en: SAKE Robotics centers its public product offering on EZGripper robotic grippers. Underactuated fingers remain approximately parallel for smaller objects and conform around larger objects; position and torque control regulate motion and grip effort.

sake-robotics.zh: EZGripper 的手指前后侧可安装附件或定制指垫。官网提供通用铝合金安装座，并说明双夹爪、三夹爪和定制安装方案，使抓取中心可与机器人腕部旋转轴对齐。
sake-robotics.en: EZGripper fingers accept attachments or custom pads on their front and rear faces. The website describes a universal aluminum mount, dual- and triple-gripper mounts and custom mounting options, including wrist-centered alignment of the grasp.
sake-robotics.locator: Product Features / EZGripper Fingers; Robot Mounts

sake-robotics.zh: 针对 Unitree G1 的套件使用专用末端安装接口，并集成线缆与供电。官网说明其软件接入 Unitree DDS，提供 DEX1 兼容接口及遥操作支持；同时列示 ROS2、Python 等接口支持。
sake-robotics.en: The Unitree G1 package uses a dedicated end-of-arm mount with integrated cabling and power. The website describes Unitree DDS integration, a DEX1-compatible interface and teleoperation support, alongside ROS2, Python and other interfaces.
sake-robotics.locator: Announcing EZGripper package for Unitree G1; Easy-to-use Software

sake-robotics.zh: 标准 EZGripper 的连接方式包括 USB 至 RS485 接口，并配套线缆和电源。官网区分包覆与指尖夹持的负载条件；通用夹爪本体、安装座与 G1 套件是不同配置层级，不能共用未经注明的质量或负载参数。
sake-robotics.en: Standard EZGripper connectivity includes a USB-to-RS485 interface with cables and power supply. The specification table distinguishes wrapping and pinch payload conditions; the gripper body, mount and G1 package are separate configuration levels rather than interchangeable mass or payload specifications.
sake-robotics.locator: Cables And Power Supply; Product Specifications

type.zh: 110 mm 行程双指电动夹爪

integration.zh: 通过 OnRobot 统一机械、电气与软件接口接入适配的工业或协作机器人；具体法兰、控制器、Compute Box、快换、线缆和软件插件按机器人型号配置。
integration.en: Integrates with supported industrial or collaborative robots through OnRobot's common mechanical, electrical, and software interface; flange, controller, Compute Box, changer, cabling, and software plug-in depend on the robot model.

verification.zh: 按工件几何确认力闭合或形闭合负载，并验证加长指尖导致的夹力下降、重心、节拍和断电保持。
verification.en: Confirm force-fit versus form-fit payload by workpiece geometry and validate force reduction from fingertip extensions, center of gravity, cycle time, and power-loss holding.

overview.zh: RG2 是 OnRobot 当前公开目录中的独立产品或变体，参数表按该型号保存，不向同系列其他型号扩展。
overview.en: RG2 is a distinct current OnRobot catalog product or variant. Its specification table is stored at model level and is not extended to adjacent models.

overview.zh: 公开数据表给出 2 kg 力闭合、5 kg 形闭合负载以及 3–40 N 可调夹力，适合尺寸变化较大的中小型工件。
overview.en: The datasheet specifies 2 kg force-fit and 5 kg form-fit payloads with 3–40 N adjustable force for varied small and medium workpieces.

applications.zh: 装配、机床上下料和拾放

integration.zh: 通过 Robotiq 控制与安装生态接入支持的协作机器人；气动型号还需核对洁净压缩空气、管径、流量、泄漏和排气条件。
integration.en: Integrates with supported cobots through Robotiq controls and mounting. Pneumatic models also require clean compressed air, tubing, airflow, leakage, and exhaust checks.

verification.zh: 通过配置器确认吸盘布局、独立通道、工件泄漏率、气源余量、机器人和紧急停止工况。
verification.en: Use the configurator to confirm cup layout, independent channels, part leakage, air-supply margin, robot, and emergency-stop case.

overview.zh: PowerPick Multi 是双真空通道、多吸盘阵列抓具，面向高负载箱体与不规则阵列搬运。
overview.en: PowerPick Multi is a dual-channel multi-cup vacuum tool for higher-payload cases and irregular arrays.

overview.zh: 30 kg 是产品级上限，不等于任意吸盘布局都可达到；工件表面、加速度、重心和机器人负载图共同限制实际结果。
overview.en: The 30 kg product limit does not apply to every cup layout; part surface, acceleration, center of gravity, and the robot load diagram jointly limit actual performance.

applications.en: Handling cases, bags, sheets, and multi-item arrays

applications.en: Palletizing, depalletizing, packaging, and machine tending
